"""One-shot public dependency metadata resolution; no Docker calls on import."""

import asyncio
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import re
import runpy
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
import tomllib
import zlib

REPO = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
FOUNDATION = REPO / "docs/poc/oracle9_python_prepare.py"
FOUNDATION_SHA = "0b0bb1719834bdc9ccaa4a2ffd4c8da23824d92320e05bf1218af734d2ede1b5"
PAYLOAD = REPO / "deploy/oracle9_dependencies.py"
IMAGE = "sha256:1546afefa358aa8c6049350948b1d5d4f272017da8997ae3974c93af7fdc07c4"
ORIGIN_TASK = "4f1d385b3e18464792773488386438dd"
ORIGIN_TAG = "maskgw-oracle9-python:" + ORIGIN_TASK
TMPFS = "rw,noexec,nosuid,nodev,size=134217728,uid=10001,gid=10001,mode=0700"


def require(value):
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError("RESOLUTION_PREPARATION_REFUSED")


def frozen_foundation():
    raw = FOUNDATION.read_bytes()
    require(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == FOUNDATION_SHA)
    namespace = {"__file__": str(FOUNDATION), "__name__": "_oracle9_frozen_preparation"}
    exec(compile(raw, str(FOUNDATION), "exec"), namespace)
    return namespace


def inputs_from_files():
    raw = (REPO / "pyproject.toml").read_bytes()
    seed = (REPO / "deploy/constraints-tested.txt").read_bytes()
    return {
        "requirements": tomllib.loads(raw.decode("utf8"))["project"]["dependencies"],
        "constraints": seed.decode("utf8"),
        "project_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        "seed_sha256": hashlib.sha256(seed).hexdigest(),
    }


def native_command(payload, inputs):
    require(len(payload) <= 65536)
    packed = base64.b64encode(zlib.compress(payload, 9)).decode("ascii")
    digest = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
    boot = (
        "import base64,zlib,hashlib; "
        "p=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(" + repr(packed) + ")); "
        "assert hashlib.sha256(p).hexdigest()==" + repr(digest) + "; "
        "exec(compile(p,'<oracle9-public-dependency-resolver>','exec'))"
    )
    encoded = base64.b64encode(json.dumps(inputs, sort_keys=True).encode()).decode("ascii")
    require(len(encoded) <= 16384)
    command = ["-c", boot, encoded]
    require(sum(len(v) for v in command) <= 26000)
    return command


def validate_owned_identity(info, task, source_sha, name):
    require(info["Name"] == "/" + name and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", info["Id"]))
    require(info["Image"] == IMAGE)
    labels = info["Config"]["Labels"]
    require(labels["maskgw.task"] == task and labels["maskgw.source-sha256"] == source_sha)
    return info["Id"]


def validate_container(info, task, source_sha, name, command, origin):
    validate_owned_identity(info, task, source_sha, name)
    c, h = info["Config"], info["HostConfig"]
    require(info["Image"] == IMAGE and c["Image"] == IMAGE and c["User"] == "10001:10001")
    require(
        c["Entrypoint"] == origin["ENTRY"] and c["Cmd"] == command and c["Env"] == origin["ENV"]
    )
    require(
        c["Labels"]["maskgw.task"] == task and c["Labels"]["maskgw.source-sha256"] == source_sha
    )
    require(h["Memory"] == h["MemorySwap"] == 512 * 1024 * 1024 and h["PidsLimit"] == 32)
    require(h["NanoCpus"] == 1000000000 and h["ShmSize"] == 1024 * 1024)
    require(h["ReadonlyRootfs"] is True and h["Privileged"] is False)
    require(
        h["NetworkMode"] == "bridge" and not h.get("PortBindings") and not h.get("PublishAllPorts")
    )
    require(not h.get("CapAdd") and h["CapDrop"] == ["ALL"])
    require(h["SecurityOpt"] in (["no-new-privileges"], ["no-new-privileges:true"]))
    require(h["Tmpfs"] == {"/tmp": TMPFS} and not h.get("Binds") and not h.get("Mounts"))
    require(h.get("IpcMode") == "private" and h.get("CgroupnsMode") == "private")
    require(h.get("PidMode", "") == "" and h.get("UTSMode", "") == "")
    require(not h.get("Devices") and not h.get("DeviceRequests") and not h.get("ExtraHosts"))
    require(h["LogConfig"]["Type"] == "none" and h["RestartPolicy"]["Name"] == "no")
    limits = {v["Name"]: (v["Soft"], v["Hard"]) for v in h["Ulimits"]}
    require(limits == {"core": (0, 0), "nofile": (128, 128)})
    mounts = info.get("Mounts", [])
    require(
        len(mounts) <= 1
        and all(
            v["Type"] == "tmpfs" and v["Destination"] == "/tmp" and not v.get("Source")
            for v in mounts
        )
    )
    require(
        not c.get("ExposedPorts")
        and not c.get("Volumes")
        and c.get("Healthcheck") in (None, {"Test": ["NONE"]})
    )
    return info["Id"]


async def main(root):
    require(os.name == "nt" and sys.flags.isolated and not sys.flags.optimize)
    require(root.parent.resolve() == (pathlib.Path(os.environ["LOCALAPPDATA"]) / "Temp").resolve())
    require(root.name.startswith("maskgw-oracle9-resolve-20261025-") and not root.is_symlink())
    require(not root.lstat().st_file_attributes & 0x400)
    state = json.loads((root / "attempt.json").read_bytes())
    require(
        state["kind"] == "maskgw-oracle9-resolve" and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{32}", state["task"])
    )
    require(
        state["invoked"] is False
        and state["phase"] == "APP_READY"
        and not (root / "result.json").exists()
    )
    require(
        hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == state["program_sha256"]
    )
    payload = PAYLOAD.read_bytes()
    require(hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() == state["payload_sha256"])
    inputs = inputs_from_files()
    require(
        inputs["project_sha256"] == state["project_sha256"]
        and inputs["seed_sha256"] == state["seed_sha256"]
    )
    ns = {"__name__": "_oracle9_resolution_policy", "__file__": str(PAYLOAD)}
    exec(compile(payload, str(PAYLOAD), "exec"), ns)
    ns["validate_inputs"](inputs)
    origin = frozen_foundation()
    origin["pins"]()
    helper = runpy.run_path(str(origin["HELPER"]))
    cli_path, save = str(origin["CLI"]), origin["save"]
    state.update(invoked=True, phase="RESOLUTION_CONSUMED")
    save(root / "attempt.json", state)
    result = {
        "profile": "oracle9-resolve",
        "task": state["task"],
        "commands": [],
        "outcome": "NOT_PASSED",
        "owned_cleanup": False,
        "inventory_restored": False,
    }
    stop, fired = threading.Event(), threading.Event()
    active = {"cid": None}
    name = "maskgw-ol9-resolve-" + state["task"][:12]
    command = native_command(payload, inputs)
    created = False

    def watchdog():
        if not stop.wait(300):
            fired.set()
            if active["cid"] is not None:
                try:
                    origin["pins"]()
                    subprocess.run(
                        [
                            cli_path,
                            "--context",
                            "desktop-linux",
                            "kill",
                            "--signal",
                            "KILL",
                            active["cid"],
                        ],
                        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                        timeout=10,
                        check=False,
                        env=helper["environment"](),
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass

    thread = threading.Thread(target=watchdog, name="maskgw-oracle9-resolve-watchdog", daemon=False)

    async def cli(label, *args, timeout=10, limit=2 * 1024 * 1024):
        origin["pins"]()
        result["stage"] = label
        started = time.monotonic()
        code, raw = await helper["bounded"](
            [cli_path, "--context", "desktop-linux", *args], timeout=timeout, limit=limit
        )
        result["commands"].append(
            {
                "name": label,
                "exit": code,
                "bytes": len(raw),
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                "seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
            }
        )
        return code, raw

    def write_new(filename, raw):
        require(len(raw) <= 2 * 1024 * 1024)
        with (root / filename).open("xb") as f:
            f.write(raw)
            f.flush()
            os.fsync(f.fileno())

    async def inspect(verify_profile=False):
        code, raw = await cli("inspect-own", "inspect", active["cid"] or name)
        require(code == 0)
        value = json.loads(raw)
        require(type(value) is list and len(value) == 1)
        cid = validate_owned_identity(value[0], state["task"], state["payload_sha256"], name)
        active["cid"] = cid
        if verify_profile:
            validate_container(
                value[0], state["task"], state["payload_sha256"], name, command, origin
            )
        return value[0], raw

    thread_started = False
    try:
        thread.start()
        thread_started = True
        code, raw = await cli("version", "version", "--format", "{{json .}}")
        require(code == 0)
        write_new("version.json", raw)
        code, raw = await cli("inventory-before", "ps", "-aq", "--no-trunc")
        require(code == 0 and not raw.strip())
        code, raw = await cli("base-image", "image", "inspect", IMAGE)
        require(code == 0)
        write_new("image-inspect.json", raw)
        values = json.loads(raw)
        require(type(values) is list and len(values) == 1)
        require(origin["validate_prepared_image"](values[0], ORIGIN_TASK, ORIGIN_TAG) == IMAGE)
        result["base_diffids"] = values[0]["RootFS"]["Layers"]
        args = [
            "create",
            "--pull=never",
            "--name",
            name,
            "--label",
            "maskgw.task=" + state["task"],
            "--label",
            "maskgw.source-sha256=" + state["payload_sha256"],
            "--user",
            "10001:10001",
            "--read-only",
            "--network",
            "bridge",
            "--cap-drop",
            "ALL",
            "--security-opt",
            "no-new-privileges",
            "--memory",
            "536870912",
            "--memory-swap",
            "536870912",
            "--pids-limit",
            "32",
            "--cpus",
            "1",
            "--shm-size",
            "1m",
            "--tmpfs",
            "/tmp:" + TMPFS,
            "--ulimit",
            "core=0:0",
            "--ulimit",
            "nofile=128:128",
            "--ipc",
            "private",
            "--cgroupns",
            "private",
            "--log-driver",
            "none",
            "--restart",
            "no",
            "--no-healthcheck",
            IMAGE,
            *command,
        ]
        require(sum(len(v) + 3 for v in args) + len(cli_path) < 28000)
        created = True
        code, raw = await cli("create-resolver", *args, timeout=20)
        require(code == 0 and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", raw.decode().strip()))
        created_id = raw.decode().strip()
        value, raw = await inspect(True)
        require(value["Id"] == created_id)
        require(not value["State"]["Running"])
        write_new("resolver-inspect-before.json", raw)
        code, raw = await cli("resolve", "start", "--attach", active["cid"], timeout=180)
        write_new("resolution.stdout", raw)
        require(code == 0 and not fired.is_set())
        packet = json.loads(raw)
        original = ns["validate_packet"](packet, inputs)
        result["projection"] = packet["projection"]
        result["raw_report_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()
        result["raw_report_bytes"] = len(original)
        result["resolution_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
        value, raw = await inspect(True)
        require(
            not value["State"]["Running"]
            and value["State"]["ExitCode"] == 0
            and value["State"]["OOMKilled"] is False
        )
        write_new("resolver-inspect-after.json", raw)
        require(
            inputs_from_files() == inputs
            and hashlib.sha256(PAYLOAD.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == state["payload_sha256"]
        )
        require(
            hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            == state["program_sha256"]
        )
        result["outcome"] = "LINUX_DEPENDENCY_REPORT_PASSED"
    except BaseException:
        result["failure_stage"] = result.get("stage", "PRECHECK")
    finally:
        clean = True
        if created:
            try:
                value, _ = await inspect()
                if value["State"]["Running"]:
                    code, _ = await cli(
                        "stop-own", "stop", "--time", "5", active["cid"], timeout=15
                    )
                    require(code == 0)
                    value, _ = await inspect()
                require(not value["State"]["Running"])
                result["state_before_cleanup"] = {
                    k: value["State"][k] for k in ("ExitCode", "OOMKilled", "Running")
                }
                result["container_id"] = active["cid"]
                code, _ = await cli("remove-own", "rm", active["cid"])
                require(code == 0)
            except BaseException:
                clean = False
        stop.set()
        if thread_started:
            thread.join(timeout=15)
        require(not thread.is_alive())
        result["watchdog_fired"] = fired.is_set()
        result["owned_cleanup"] = clean
        try:
            code, raw = await cli("inventory-after", "ps", "-aq", "--no-trunc")
            result["inventory_restored"] = code == 0 and not raw.strip()
        except BaseException:
            result["inventory_restored"] = False
        if not clean or not result["inventory_restored"] or fired.is_set():
            result["outcome"] = "NOT_PASSED"
        save(root / "result.json", result)
        print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in result.items() if k != "projection"}))
    return 0 if result["outcome"] == "LINUX_DEPENDENCY_REPORT_PASSED" else 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    require(len(sys.argv) == 2)
    raise SystemExit(asyncio.run(main(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]))))

"""Public native-Linux dependency resolution; no calls on import, no application."""

import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import re
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import urllib.parse
import zlib

MAX_RAW = 16 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_ENVELOPE = 2 * 1024 * 1024
CERT = "/etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt"
CONFIGS = ("/etc/pip.conf", "/etc/xdg/pip/pip.conf", "/opt/maskgw/venv/pip.conf")
INDEX = "https://pypi.org/simple"


def require(value):
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError("DEPENDENCY_RESOLUTION_REFUSED")


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def name_key(value):
    require(type(value) is str and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,100}", value))
    return re.sub(r"[-_.]+", "-", value).lower()


def validate_inputs(value):
    require(
        type(value) is dict
        and set(value) == {"requirements", "constraints", "project_sha256", "seed_sha256"}
    )
    require(type(value["constraints"]) is str and len(value["constraints"].encode()) <= 8192)
    require(sha(value["constraints"].encode()) == value["seed_sha256"])
    require(re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", value["project_sha256"]) is not None)
    pins = {}
    for line in value["constraints"].splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        m = re.fullmatch(r"([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)==([A-Za-z0-9.!+_]+)", line)
        require(m is not None)
        key = name_key(m[1])
        require(key not in pins)
        pins[key] = m[2]
    require(1 <= len(pins) <= 32)
    roots = []
    reqs = value["requirements"]
    require(type(reqs) is list and 1 <= len(reqs) <= 32)
    for req in reqs:
        require(type(req) is str and len(req) <= 256 and req.isascii())
        require(not any(c in req for c in ("\r", "\n", "\x00", "@", ":", "/", "\\")))
        m = re.match(r"([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*)(?:\[[A-Za-z0-9_,.-]+\])?(?=[<>=!~;]|$)", req)
        require(m is not None)
        key = name_key(m[1])
        require(key in pins and key not in roots)
        roots.append(key)
    return pins, roots


def wheel_filename(filename, package, version, glibc):
    require(type(filename) is str and len(filename) <= 256)
    require(re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.+!-]+\.whl", filename) is not None)
    parts = filename[:-4].split("-")
    require(len(parts) in (5, 6))
    require(name_key(parts[0]) == package and parts[1] == version)
    if len(parts) == 6:
        require(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.]*", parts[2]) is not None)
    py, abi, platform = parts[-3:]
    if platform == "any":
        require(py in ("py3", "py2.py3") and abi == "none")
        return
    require(
        py == "cp311"
        and abi == "cp311"
        or abi == "abi3"
        and re.fullmatch(r"cp3(?:[2-9]|10|11)", py)
    )
    aliases = {
        "manylinux1_x86_64": (2, 5),
        "manylinux2010_x86_64": (2, 12),
        "manylinux2014_x86_64": (2, 17),
    }
    for tag in platform.split("."):
        minimum = aliases.get(tag)
        if minimum is None:
            m = re.fullmatch(r"manylinux_(2)_([0-9]{1,2})_x86_64", tag)
            require(m is not None)
            minimum = (int(m[1]), int(m[2]))
        require(minimum <= glibc)


def project_report(report, inputs, glibc):
    pins, roots = validate_inputs(inputs)
    require(
        type(report) is dict and set(report) == {"version", "pip_version", "install", "environment"}
    )
    require(report["version"] == "0" and report["pip_version"] == "22.3.1")
    require(
        type(glibc) is tuple and len(glibc) == 2 and all(type(v) is int and v >= 0 for v in glibc)
    )
    environment = report["environment"]
    expected = {
        "sys_platform": "linux",
        "platform_machine": "x86_64",
        "python_full_version": "3.11.13",
        "implementation_name": "cpython",
        "platform_system": "Linux",
    }
    require(type(environment) is dict and all(environment.get(k) == v for k, v in expected.items()))
    require(
        all(type(k) is str and type(v) is str and len(v) <= 512 for k, v in environment.items())
    )
    rows = report["install"]
    require(type(rows) is list and 1 <= len(rows) <= 64)
    files, seen, seen_files = [], set(), set()
    for item in rows:
        require(
            type(item) is dict
            and set(item)
            in (
                {"is_direct", "requested", "download_info", "metadata"},
                {"is_direct", "requested", "download_info", "metadata", "requested_extras"},
            )
        )
        require(item["is_direct"] is False and type(item["requested"]) is bool)
        metadata = item["metadata"]
        key, version = name_key(metadata["name"]), metadata["version"]
        require(type(version) is str and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9.!+_]+", version) is not None)
        require(key not in seen and key not in {"pywin32", "pypiwin32", "pywin32-ctypes"})
        require(key not in pins or pins[key] == version)
        seen.add(key)
        require(item["requested"] == (key in roots))
        extras = item.get("requested_extras", [])
        require(type(extras) is list and len(extras) <= 8 and all(name_key(v) == v for v in extras))
        require(extras == sorted(set(extras)))
        download = item["download_info"]
        require(type(download) is dict and set(download) == {"url", "archive_info"})
        url = download["url"]
        require(type(url) is str and url.isascii() and len(url) <= 2048)
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
        require(parsed.scheme == "https" and parsed.netloc == "files.pythonhosted.org")
        require(url == urllib.parse.urlunsplit(parsed))
        require(not parsed.query and not parsed.fragment and parsed.path.startswith("/packages/"))
        require(re.fullmatch(r"/packages/[A-Za-z0-9/._+!-]+", parsed.path) is not None)
        require(all(part not in ("", ".", "..") for part in parsed.path.split("/")[1:]))
        filename = urllib.parse.unquote(parsed.path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1], errors="strict")
        wheel_filename(filename, key, version, glibc)
        require(filename not in seen_files)
        seen_files.add(filename)
        archive = download["archive_info"]
        require(type(archive) is dict and set(archive) == {"hash"})
        require(
            type(archive["hash"]) is str and re.fullmatch("sha256=[0-9a-f]{64}", archive["hash"])
        )
        requires_python = metadata.get("requires_python")
        require(
            requires_python is None or type(requires_python) is str and len(requires_python) <= 256
        )
        requires_dist = metadata.get("requires_dist", [])
        require(type(requires_dist) is list and len(requires_dist) <= 128)
        require(
            all(
                type(v) is str and len(v) <= 1024 and "\x00" not in v and "\n" not in v
                for v in requires_dist
            )
        )
        files.append(
            {
                "name": key,
                "version": version,
                "url": url,
                "filename": filename,
                "sha256": archive["hash"][7:],
                "requires_python": requires_python,
                "requires_dist": requires_dist,
                "requested": item["requested"],
                "requested_extras": extras,
            }
        )
    require(set(pins) <= seen and set(roots) <= seen)
    return {
        "schema": "oracle9-pip22-projection-v1",
        "pip_version": "22.3.1",
        "report_version": "0",
        "environment": environment,
        "glibc": list(glibc),
        "index_url": INDEX,
        "files": sorted(files, key=lambda v: v["name"]),
    }


def pack_report(raw):
    require(type(raw) is bytes and 0 < len(raw) <= MAX_RAW)
    packed = base64.b64encode(zlib.compress(raw, 9)).decode("ascii")
    require(len(packed) <= MAX_ENVELOPE)
    return {"encoding": "zlib-base64-v1", "raw_bytes": len(raw), "sha256": sha(raw), "data": packed}


def unpack_report(value):
    require(type(value) is dict and set(value) == {"encoding", "raw_bytes", "sha256", "data"})
    require(
        value["encoding"] == "zlib-base64-v1"
        and type(value["raw_bytes"]) is int
        and 0 < value["raw_bytes"] <= MAX_RAW
    )
    require(type(value["data"]) is str and len(value["data"]) <= MAX_ENVELOPE)
    packed = base64.b64decode(value["data"], validate=True)
    stream = zlib.decompressobj()
    raw = stream.decompress(packed, MAX_RAW + 1)
    require(stream.eof and not stream.unused_data and not stream.unconsumed_tail)
    require(len(raw) == value["raw_bytes"] and sha(raw) == value["sha256"])
    return raw


def child_environment():
    return {
        "PATH": "/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin",
        "HOME": "/var/empty",
        "LANG": "C.UTF-8",
        "TMPDIR": "/tmp/maskgw-resolve",
    }


def validate_packet(value, inputs):
    require(
        type(value) is dict
        and set(value)
        == {
            "kind",
            "projection",
            "raw",
            "diagnostic",
            "config_absent",
            "child_environment",
            "cert",
            "inputs",

                        [
                            str(CLI),
                            "--context",
                            "desktop-linux",
                            "kill",
                            "--signal",
                            "KILL",
                            active["cid"],
                        ],
                        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                        env=mod["environment"](),
                        timeout=10,
                        check=False,
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass

    thread = threading.Thread(target=watchdog, name="maskgw-oracle9-python-watchdog", daemon=False)

    async def cli(label, *args, timeout=10, limit=2 * 1024 * 1024):
        pins()
        result["stage"] = label
        t = time.monotonic()
        try:
            rc, raw = await bounded(
                [str(CLI), "--context", "desktop-linux", *args], timeout=timeout, limit=limit
            )
        except BaseException as e:
            category = (
                "CLI_TIMEOUT"
                if type(e) is TimeoutError
                else e.category
                if type(e) is mod["HostFault"]
                else "CLI_OS"
                if isinstance(e, OSError)
                else "CLI_FAULT"
            )
            result["commands"].append(
                {"name": label, "category": category, "exit": None, "seconds": time.monotonic() - t}
            )
            raise
        result["commands"].append(
            {
                "name": label,
                "exit": rc,
                "category": "OK" if rc == 0 else "NONZERO",
                "seconds": time.monotonic() - t,
                "bytes": len(raw),
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            }
        )
        return rc, raw

    async def inspect(target):
        rc, raw = await cli("inspect-own", "inspect", "--type", "container", target)
        require(rc == 0)
        rows = json.loads(raw)
        require(type(rows) is list and len(rows) == 1)
        return rows[0]

    async def unused_tag():
        # image ls is successful even when absent; daemon errors never mean absent.
        rc, raw = await cli(
            "tag-collision",
            "image",
            "ls",
            "--no-trunc",
            "--format",
            "{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}",
            tag,
        )
        require(rc == 0 and not raw.strip())

    async def create(image, suffix, command, prep):
        name = "maskgw-ol9-python-" + state["task"][:12] + "-" + suffix
        record = {"name": name, "image": image, "cid": None}
        records.append(record)
        mb, fds, pids = ("2g", "256", "64") if prep else ("128m", "64", "16")
        args = [
            "create",
            "--pull",
            "never",
            "--name",
            name,
            "--label",
            "maskgw.task=" + state["task"],
            "--network",
            "none",
            "--ipc",
            "private",
            "--cgroupns",
            "private",
            "--user",
            "0:0" if prep else "10001:10001",
            "--cap-drop",
            "ALL",
            "--security-opt",
            "no-new-privileges=true",
            "--memory",
            mb,
            "--memory-swap",
            mb,
            "--pids-limit",
            pids,
            "--cpus",
            "1",
            "--shm-size",
            "1m",
            "--ulimit",
            "nofile=" + fds + ":" + fds,
            "--ulimit",
            "core=0:0",
            "--restart",
            "no",
            "--log-driver",
            "none",
            "--no-healthcheck",
        ]
        if prep:
            args += ["--entrypoint", "/bin/bash"]
            args += [v for cap in sorted(PREP_CAPS) for v in ("--cap-add", cap)]
        else:
            args += ["--read-only"]
        rc, raw = await cli("create-" + suffix, *args, image, *command, timeout=20)
        require(rc == 0 and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", raw.decode("ascii").strip()))
        record["cid"] = raw.decode("ascii").strip()
        info = await inspect(record["cid"])
        identity(info, name, state["task"], image)
        profile(info, image, command, prep)
        active["cid"] = record["cid"]
        return record

    try:
        rc, raw = await cli("version", "version", "--format", "{{json .Server}}")
        require(rc == 0 and json.loads(raw)["Os"] == "linux" and json.loads(raw)["Arch"] == "amd64")
        rc, raw = await cli("inventory-before", "ps", "-aq", "--no-trunc")
        require(rc == 0 and not raw.strip())
        rc, raw = await cli("daemon-memory", "info", "--format", "{{json .MemTotal}}")
        require(rc == 0)
        total = json.loads(raw)
        require(type(total) is int and total >= 8 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024)
        result["daemon_memory_total"] = total
        await unused_tag()
        rc, raw = await cli("base-image", "image", "inspect", IMAGE)
        require(rc == 0)
        base = json.loads(raw)[0]
        require(
            base["Id"] == IMAGE
            and base["Config"]["Env"] == [PATH_ENV]
            and base["RootFS"]["Layers"] == BASE_LAYERS
        )
        require(not any(base["Config"].get(k) for k in ("Volumes", "ExposedPorts", "Healthcheck")))
        require(base["Config"]["Cmd"] == ["/bin/bash"])
        script = shell(payload, state["task"])
        require(len(script) < 25000)
        thread.start()
        prep = await create(IMAGE, "prep", ["-c", script], True)
        download_module["check_bundle"](root, state)
        rc, _ = await cli(
            "copy-bundle",
            "cp",
            str(root / "bundle"),
            prep["cid"] + ":/maskgw-rpm-input-" + state["task"],
            timeout=30,
        )
        require(rc == 0)
        info = await inspect(prep["cid"])
        identity(info, prep["name"], state["task"], IMAGE)
        profile(info, IMAGE, ["-c", script], True)
        require(info["State"]["Running"] is False)
        rc, raw = await cli("install-runtime", "start", "--attach", prep["cid"], timeout=300)
        with (root / "install.stdout").open("xb") as f:
            f.write(raw)
            f.flush()
            os.fsync(f.fileno())
        require(rc == 0 and raw.count(b"@@RUNTIME@@") == 1)
        report = decode_summary(raw.split(b"@@RUNTIME@@")[1])
        require(
            report["python"] == [3, 11, 13]
            and report["base_verify_accepted"] is True
            and report["os_unchanged"] is True
        )
        result["runtime"] = report
        payload_policy(report)
        require(
            report["no_new_privilege_bits_or_caps"] is True
            and type(report["privilege_checked_nodes"]) is int
            and report["privilege_checked_nodes"] > 0
        )
        info = await inspect(prep["cid"])
        identity(info, prep["name"], state["task"], IMAGE)
        require(
            not info["State"]["Running"]
            and info["State"]["ExitCode"] == 0
            and not info["State"]["OOMKilled"]
        )
        rc, raw = await cli("diff", "diff", prep["cid"])
        require(rc == 0)
        with (root / "diff.txt").open("xb") as f:
            f.write(raw)
            f.flush()
            os.fsync(f.fileno())
        validate_diff(raw, report)
        await unused_tag()
        changes = [
            "USER 10001:10001",
            "WORKDIR /var/empty",
            "ENTRYPOINT " + json.dumps(ENTRY),
            "CMD []",
            "ENV " + " ".join(ENV[1:]),
        ]
        args = [value for change in changes for value in ("--change", change)]
        rc, raw = await cli(
            "commit-image", "commit", "--pause=false", *args, prep["cid"], tag, timeout=60
        )
        with (root / "commit.stdout").open("xb") as f:
            f.write(raw)
            f.flush()
            os.fsync(f.fileno())
        require(rc == 0)
        # Human-facing commit stdout is evidence only, never the image selector.
        # This unique own tag was absent just before commit. Metadata is authoritative.
        rc, raw = await cli("prepared-inspect", "image", "inspect", tag)
        require(rc == 0)
        values = json.loads(raw)
        require(type(values) is list and len(values) == 1)
        image = validate_prepared_image(values[0], state["task"], tag)
        result["prepared_image"] = image
        result["prepared_tag"] = tag
        probe = await create(image, "probe", ["/opt/maskgw/runtime_probe.py", "probe"], False)
        rc, raw = await cli("probe", "start", "--attach", probe["cid"], timeout=20, limit=16384)
        require(rc == 0)
        result["probe"] = json.loads(raw)
        require(result["probe"]["runtime_sha256"] == report["runtime_sha256"])
        require(
            result["probe"]["kind"] == "oracle9-python-probe" and result["probe"]["uid"] == 10001
        )
        info = await inspect(probe["cid"])
        identity(info, probe["name"], state["task"], image)
        require(
            not info["State"]["Running"]
            and info["State"]["ExitCode"] == 0
            and not info["State"]["OOMKilled"]
        )
        result["outcome"] = "PYTHON_RUNTIME_PASSED"
    except BaseException:
        result["failure_stage"] = result.get("stage", "PRECHECK")
    finally:
        clean = True
        for record in reversed(records):
            try:
                info = await inspect(record["cid"] or record["name"])
                cid = identity(info, record["name"], state["task"], record["image"])
                record["cid"] = cid
                record["state_before_cleanup"] = {
                    key: info["State"][key] for key in ("Running", "ExitCode", "OOMKilled")
                }
                if info["State"]["Running"]:
                    rc, _ = await cli("stop-own", "stop", "--time", "5", cid, timeout=15)
                    require(rc == 0)
                    info = await inspect(cid)
                    identity(info, record["name"], state["task"], record["image"])
                    require(not info["State"]["Running"])
                rc, _ = await cli("remove-own", "rm", cid, timeout=20)
                require(rc == 0)
                if active["cid"] == cid:
                    active["cid"] = None
            except BaseException:
                clean = False
        stop.set()
        if thread.ident is not None:
            thread.join(timeout=12)
        result["owned_cleanup"] = clean and not thread.is_alive() and not fired.is_set()
        result["containers"] = records
        try:
            rc, raw = await cli("inventory-after", "ps", "-aq", "--no-trunc")
            result["inventory_restored"] = rc == 0 and not raw.strip()
        except BaseException:
            pass
        if not result["owned_cleanup"] or not result["inventory_restored"]:
            result["outcome"] = "NOT_PASSED"
        save(root / "result.json", result)
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in result.items() if k != "runtime"}, sort_keys=True))
    return 0 if result["outcome"] == "PYTHON_RUNTIME_PASSED" else 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    require(len(sys.argv) == 2)
    raise SystemExit(asyncio.run(main(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]))))

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "maskgw"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "AI Data Masking Gateway"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = [
    # SDK MCP oficial, linha v2. O pin impede um major incompativel.
    "mcp>=2.1,<3",
    "pglast>=6",
    "psycopg[binary]>=3.1",
    "pydantic>=2.6",
    "PyYAML>=6",
    # Fase 9, Etapa 2: AES-256-GCM, HKDF e primitives de integridade do
    # catálogo cifrado. O pin mantém o envelope e os vetores reprodutíveis.
    "cryptography==50.0.1",
    # Fase 9, Etapa 7 (D-109): SASLprep e derivacao do verifier SCRAM-SHA-256
    # pela API publica `make_auth_info`. A troca de mensagens do servidor e
    # propria: o parser da scramp rejeita o `n=` vazio que o libpq envia
    # (medido). `asn1crypto` e a dependencia transitiva, fixada junto.
    "scramp==1.4.17",
    "asn1crypto==1.5.1",
    # Fase 7, Etapa 7: a fronteira HTTP administrativa. Entram juntas e so
    # agora, porque a especificacao condicionava a adocao do FastAPI a
    # aprovacao da Fase 7 (secao 14.2). Sao usadas EXCLUSIVAMENTE pelo plano
    # administrativo: o MCP continua stdio only (D-036), e nenhuma porta e
    # aberta sem MASKGW_ADMIN_ENABLED=1.
    "fastapi>=0.110",
    # >= 0.29 por causa de `timeout_graceful_shutdown`: e ele que limita a
    # espera do SERVIDOR por requisicoes em voo, para que o `join` do shutdown
    # possa ser integral sem risco de prender o processo (D-057).
    "uvicorn>=0.29",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8",
    "ruff>=0.6",
    "mypy>=1.11",
    "types-PyYAML",
]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
pythonpath = ["src"]
testpaths = ["tests"]
addopts = "-q --strict-markers"
markers = [
    "integration: exige um PostgreSQL real via MASKGW_TEST_DSN; skip sem ela",
]

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py311"
src = ["src", "tests"]
# PoCs em `docs/poc/` nao sao produto (fora do wheel/sdist, nao importadas por
# `maskgw`): o truque de `sys.path` e os imports apos codigo sao deliberados.
extend-exclude = ["docs/poc"]

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [
    "E", "W",   # pycodestyle
    "F",        # pyflakes
    "I",        # isort
    "N",        # pep8-naming
    "UP",       # pyupgrade
    "B",        # bugbear
    "S",        # bandit
    "C4",       # comprehensions
    "SIM",      # simplify
    "RET",      # return
    "ARG",      # unused arguments
    "ANN",      # annotations
    "TID",      # tidy imports
    "PL",       # pylint
    "RUF",
]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"tests/*" = ["S101", "PLR2004", "ANN"]
# Os arquivos de integracao e de sondagem montam SQL a partir de constantes do
# proprio modulo, nunca de entrada externa. A validacao de SQL do Gateway e da
# Fase 4.
"tests/test_db_integration.py" = ["S608"]
"tests/test_datasource_runtime_integration.py" = ["S608"]
"tests/test_admin_v2_integration.py" = ["S608"]
"tests/test_pgresult_metadata.py" = ["S608"]
"tests/test_execution_safety.py" = ["S608"]
# Os testes adversariais do validator PRECISAM montar SQL maliciosa: e o que
# esta sendo testado. Nenhuma delas chega a um banco.
"tests/test_sql_validator.py" = ["S608"]
"tests/test_mcp_integration.py" = ["S608"]
"tests/test_mcp_server.py" = ["S608"]
"tests/test_audit.py" = ["S608"]
"tests/test_gateway.py" = ["S608"]
# A suite adversarial PRECISA montar SQL de ataque: e o objeto do teste.
# Os homoglifos Unicode (RUF001) sao exatamente o que se testa.
"tests/security/*" = ["S608", "RUF001"]
"tests/test_sensitivity.py" = ["S608"]
# Fase 7, Etapa 7 — a suite da fronteira HTTP administrativa.
#
# Os codigos abaixo sao propriedades do que esta sendo testado, e nao descuido:
#
# ARG001/ARG002  uma app ASGI precisa aceitar `(scope, receive, send)` mesmo
#                quando nao usa os tres; a assinatura e o protocolo.
# N802           varios testes gritam a parte que importa no nome —
#                `..._vem_ANTES_do_415`, `..._e_NOT_FOUND` — porque e a ordem
#                entre camadas que o teste existe para fixar.
# PLC0415        imports locais, para nao carregar em modulo o que so um teste
#                usa (`hashlib`, `json`, `Runtime`).
# S104/S105/S106 `0.0.0.0` e o bind que o startup TEM de recusar, e os tokens
#                sao marcadores de teste que os testes de vazamento procuram.
#                Nenhum e credencial real.
# S310           `urlopen` contra `127.0.0.1`, com esquema fixo no proprio
#                teste; e o cliente HTTP do teste de coexistencia com o MCP.
# S324           `md5` usado para PROVAR que o hash de um segredo nao aparece
#                na resposta — o oposto de usar md5 para proteger algo.
# S608           SQL montada a partir de constantes do proprio modulo, como nos
#                demais arquivos de integracao.
# PLR0913        o cliente HTTP cru: cada header controlavel e um parametro.
# RUF012         tabela de dados de teste declarada como atributo de classe.
"tests/admin_http_support.py" = ["ARG001", "PLC0415", "PLR0913", "S105"]
"tests/test_admin_http_boundary.py" = ["ARG001", "ARG002", "N802", "PLC0415"]
"tests/test_admin_http_leakage.py" = ["ARG002", "N802", "S106", "S324"]
"tests/test_admin_http_lifecycle.py" = ["ARG001", "N802", "PLC0415", "S104", "S106"]
"tests/test_admin_http_mcp_coexistence.py" = ["S106", "S310", "S608"]
"tests/test_admin_audit.py" = ["PLC0415", "S105"]
"tests/test_admin_http_audit.py" = ["S105"]
"tests/test_admin_http_reads.py" = ["N802", "PLC0415", "RUF012", "S105"]
"tests/test_admin_http_settings.py" = ["S104", "S105"]
"tests/test_admin_http_surface.py" = ["N802", "PLC0415", "S106"]
"tests/test_admin_http_writes.py" = ["S105"]
"tests/test_admin_http_writes_e2e.py" = ["S105", "S608"]
# O subprocesso mede o que `maskgw.admin` carrega; interpretador e programa sao
# constantes do proprio teste, como em `test_purity.py`.
"tests/test_plan_separation.py" = ["S603"]
# Fase 9, Etapa 7 — gate pos-conexao em processo filho.
#
# S105/S106/S107 senhas de teste (marcadores que os canarios de vazamento
#                procuram); nenhuma e credencial real.
# PLC0415        imports locais de `conninfo_to_dict`, usados so num teste.
# S603           subprocesso com interpretador e codigo fixos do proprio teste,
#                sem shell — o filho de importacao isolada.
"tests/test_datasource_verify_gate.py" = ["PLC0415", "S105", "S106", "S107", "S603"]
# Fase 9, Etapa 7 (D-109) — pecas puras do startup PGWire.
#
# S105/S106      senhas de teste (marcadores procurados nos testes de
#                vazamento); nenhuma e credencial real.
# RUF001         os caracteres Unicode ambiguos (espaco nao separavel, bidi)
#                sao exatamente o que o SASLprep tem de tratar.
# PLR0913        o cliente SCRAM minimo do teste: cada campo adulteravel e um
#                parametro.
"tests/test_pgwire_scram.py" = ["PLR0913", "RUF001", "S105", "S106"]
# Fase 9, Etapa 7 (D-110) — settings: senha e usuario de teste sao marcadores
# procurados nos testes de vazamento (S105); o digito de largura total e o
# arabe-indico (RUF001) sao exatamente o que o parse estrito tem de recusar.
"tests/test_pgwire_settings.py" = ["RUF001", "S105"]

[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports]
ban-relative-imports = "parents"

[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.11"
mypy_path = "src"
strict = true
warn_unreachable = true
plugins = ["pydantic.mypy"]

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = "tests.*"
disallow_untyped_defs = false

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
